name: 600 EX six-speed rear freehub
weight_description: Weight not yet sourced without skewers: the catalogue’s 405 g rear figure excludes sprockets but does not establish quick-release exclusion. Its FH-6208-R label corresponds to the six-speed assembly identified as FH-6208-6 in the manufacturer drawing; no QR mass is subtracted.
